verdicts.reason: A keeps a centred axis, but the headline and subcopy are undersized for the canvas, the logo is tiny, there are big dead gaps between headline, copy and product, and the order changes so the headline sits above the product. B keeps the original reading order (logo, product, headline, copy, CTA) on one centred axis, but the text block is jammed into the lower third, the subcopy runs onto the decorative circle, and the headline is still small. A is centred and clean, but it moves the headline above the product, leaves a large empty gap under the subcopy, and the headline and logo are undersized.
